title: Cogenesis of visible and dark matter in type-I Dirac seesaw
summary: We propose a novel cogenesis framework based on the type-I Dirac seesaw mechanism. The minimal type-I Dirac seesaw with three heavy vector-like fermions $(N)$, one singlet scalar $(η)$, and the right-handed counterparts $(ν_R)$ of the Standard Model (SM) neutrinos is extended to include a Dirac fermion dark matter (DM) $(χ)$ and its heavier scalar companion ($φ$).
